name: C++ for +2 Students
title: C++ for +2 Students — basics dekhi OOP samma
short: C++ programming ko foundation basics bata siknuhos. Programming logic, variables, data types, operators, conditions, loops, functions ra aru important concepts step-by-step bujhdai practical coding practice garnuhos.
goals: C++ program lekhna, compile ra run garna
Variables, data types ra operators bujhna
if-else, switch ra loops bata programming logic banauna
Arrays ra strings sanga kaam garna
Functions banauna ra function overloading bujhna
Classes ra objects ko basic concept bujhna
Constructors, inheritance ra polymorphism ko suruwat garna
Euta sano mini project aafai banauna
desc: Yo course Class 11 ka Computer Science students lai dhyan ma rakhera banaieko ho — programming pahilo choti sikdai hunuhunchha bhane pani basics bata suru garna saknuhunchha. Class 12 ma OOP padhdai gareka students lai pani yo course ko pachhillo bhag kaam lagchha.
Sabai classes IT Wala Dai App ma hunchhan — live class chhutyo bhane recording hernuhos, notes download garnuhos ra har chapter pachhi practice questions solve garnuhos.
reqs: Laptop/computer ramro — phone ma online compiler pani chalchha
Sikne icchha — baaki Dai le sambhalchha!
audience: Class 12 ma OOP ra C++ revise garna chahane students
Pahilo choti programming sikdai gareka students
Pachhi BSc CSIT / BIT / BCA padhna chahane students

Files ra folders systematically manage garna
Sahi finger position sanga typing speed ra accuracy badhauna
Internet, email ra cloud storage safe tarika le use garna
Word processor ma document, letter ra CV banauna
Spreadsheet ma formulas, functions ra charts use garna
Presentation slides design garera present garna
Computer ko basic problems aafai troubleshoot garna
desc: Yo course Class 12 ka students ra general computer knowledge majboot banauna chahane jo-sukai ka lagi ho. Computer chalaunu dekhi documents, spreadsheets ra presentations samma — har topic practical example ra practice sanga sikinchha.
Sabai classes IT Wala Dai App ma hunchhan — live class, recordings, notes ra practice tasks ek thau ma. Course ko anta ma euta final project garera aafno skills check garnuhunchha.

Office ra digital tools practical tarika le sikna chahane students
